title: Oven Roasted French Goat Souffle
description: A comforting French Normandy dish featuring goat meat in a souffle form, served in a cataplana vessel, with an earthy and juicy flavor profile, and a vegan-friendly twist.

ingredients.name: goat meat substitute
ingredients.notes: such as seitan or textured vegetable protein

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a pan, saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushroom duxelles and cook until fragrant.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, vegetable broth, nutritional yeast, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked onion and mushroom mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the goat meat substitute and stir until well coated with the mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a cataplana vessel.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the souffle.
Cover the vessel with a lid and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the lid and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the souffle is puffed and golden brown.
